mapper.sql: id, source_type, owner_user_id, scope_type, scope_branch_id, scope_manager_id, product_name, product_code, product_type, risk_level, investment_horizon, liquidity_type, min_amount, return_type, target_customer, tags, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investment_product ( source_type, owner_user_id, scope_type, scope_branch_id, scope_manager_id, product_name, product_code, product_type, risk_level, investment_horizon, liquidity_type, min_amount, return_type, target_customer, tags, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceType}, #{ownerUserId}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeBranchId}, #{scopeManagerId}, #{productName}, #{productCode}, #{productType}, #{riskLevel}, #{investmentHorizon}, #{liquidityType}, #{minAmount}, #{returnType}, #{targetCustomer}, #{tags}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE investment_product SET product_name = #{productName}, product_code = #{productCode}, scope_type = #{scopeType}, scope_branch_id = #{scopeBranchId}, scope_manager_id = #{scopeManagerId}, product_type = #{productType}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, investment_horizon = #{investmentHorizon}, liquidity_type = #{liquidityType}, min_amount = #{minAmount}, return_type = #{returnType}, target_customer = #{targetCustomer}, tags = #{tags}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM investment_product WHERE source_type = 'PERSONAL' AND owner_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
